answer.justification: Only logit-level measurements are available. Top-1 agreement is 0.855, sequence agreement 0.344, KL 0.334, TV 0.148 and Token-DiFR gap 0.529. All of these sit at or just past the edge of the system-prompted range (agreement 0.861-0.908, KL 0.197-0.339, TV 0.108-0.144, DiFR 0.28-0.52, sequence agreement 0.31-0.48). They are well outside the fine-tuned range (KL up to 0.205, agreement 0.900-0.938, DiFR up to 0.31) and the quantized range (KL up to 0.071). The raw-score shift ratio of 3.1 is not decisive, though it is closest to the system-prompted range of 3.3-3.9. Fine-tuned is the next closest alternative, but the logit shift is too large for it. Base is ruled out because the differences are non-zero.
